title: Resolved ML model recipe options
description: What `mdux-mlbake` was asked to do: the shape of the network, the scratch it needs, and the golden vectors that make `Classifier1D::create()` fail closed on a mismatch. Describes the **resolved** option set a baker records in `report.json`'s `options`, with every default expanded - not the literal TOML a recipe file carries. ADR-007 decision 4 is why: a silently changed default must not leave every report looking unchanged, so the report records what the bake actually did, and this documents that. Checked against every committed report by tools/docs-lint/check_schema_type_drift.py.

layerCount.description: Layers in the network, as resolved from the recipe.

maxScratchFloats.description: The scratch a caller must supply, computed from the layer shapes rather than declared - so a device sizes its buffer from the artifact instead of from a number somebody kept up to date.

goldenCount.description: How many golden input/output pairs the package carries.

goldenSeed.description: The seed the golden inputs were generated from. Recorded because a golden set nobody can regenerate is a golden set nobody can review.

goldenPrng.description: The generator the seed drives. A closed set of one: the algorithm is written out in `tools/ml/GoldenGen.cpp` rather than taken from a library, so that regenerating a golden set does not depend on a standard library's implementation choices.
